factor_dict.ANOM_MAX20:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = ret.rolling(21).max()
factor_dict.ANOM_OVERNIGHT:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']
out = (ao / ac.shift(1) - 1).rolling(21).sum()
factor_dict.ANOM_INTRADAY:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ao = d['open'] * d['adj_factor']
out = (ac / ao - 1).rolling(21).sum()
factor_dict.ANOM_AMIHUD:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = (ret.abs() / d['amount'].replace(0, np.nan)).rolling(21).mean()
factor_dict.ANOM_IDIOVOL:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
mkt = get_stock_index('000001', 'close').pct_change()
beta = rolling_regbeta(ret, mkt, 252)
resid = ret - beta * mkt
out = resid.rolling(21).std()
factor_dict.ANOM_ACCRUALS:
te = d['每股净资产'] * d['总股本']
ta = te / (1 - d['资产负债率'].replace(0, np.nan))
out = (d['每股收益'] - d['每股经营现金流净额']) * d['总股本'] / ta
factor_dict.ANOM_ASSETGROWTH: out = d['总资产较年初增长-%']
factor_dict.ANOM_REVERSAL_M1:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = -ret.rolling(21).sum()
factor_dict.ANOM_REVERSAL_Y1:
ac = d['close'] * d['adj_factor']
ret = ac / ac.shift(1) - 1
out = -ret.rolling(252).sum()
